title: Aid stations — food and drink matrix for Lavaredo 120K
publisher: La Sportiva Lavaredo Ultra Trail by UTMB
claims: Ospitale lists Näak drink mix, Näak bars, Näak waffles, tarts, chocolate, biscuits, sugar, jam, bread, bananas, apricots, apples, oranges, lemons, raisins, almonds and dried apricots; it does not list salami, cheese, Nutella, broth, soup, rice, fruit salad, tomatoes, eggs, potatoes or gluten-free items.
Passo Tre Croci adds cheese, Nutella, broth and soup to the Ospitale list but still does not list salami, rice, fruit salad, apricots, tomatoes, eggs, potatoes or gluten-free items.
Misurina adds salami, fruit salad and gluten-free items, but does not list rice, apricots, tomatoes, eggs or potatoes.
Cimabanche is the only station whose column marks every listed item, including rice, fruit salad, tomatoes, eggs, potatoes and gluten-free items.
Malga Ra Stua lists every item except gluten-free products.
Rifugio Col Gallina lists rice, fruit salad and gluten-free items but does not list apples, tomatoes, eggs or potatoes.
Passo Giau lists rice, fruit salad and tomatoes but does not list Nutella, jam, apples, eggs, potatoes or gluten-free items.
Rifugio Croda da Lago lists eggs and potatoes but does not list biscuits, rice, fruit salad, apricots, apples, tomatoes or gluten-free items.
All eight refreshment stations list hot tea, Coca-Cola, cold tea, water and sparkling water.
